description:
* Client Acquisition & Market Expansion: Identify and develop new business opportunities across key verticals, including Factories, Offices & Buildings, Residential complexes, Education, Hospitality, and Enterprise projects.
* Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-term strategic relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, project developers, consultants, general contractors, and strategic partners.
* Solution Consulting & Proposal Development: Analyze client requirements to recommend tailored ICT/ELV/System Integration solutions; collaborate closely with the Presales and Technical teams to prepare detailed Bills of Materials (BOM), technical proposals, and quotations.
* Pitching & Deal Closing: Deliver solution presentations, negotiate contract terms, lead commercial discussions, and track tender opportunities (RFI / RFQ / RFP).
* Sales Operations & Project Delivery: Manage the sales pipeline and revenue forecasting via CRM; monitor project revenues and margins; coordinate with the Technical/Project team to ensure smooth implementation and handover.
requirements_text:
* Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Information Technology, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications, or related fields.
* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in B2B Sales, Account Management, or Solution Sales; strong domain knowledge in ICT, ELV, Networking, and CCTV systems is highly preferred.
* Core Competencies: Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with a solution-selling mindset; proven ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.
* Technical Skills & Languages: Proficient in Microsoft Office suite; strong reading comprehension skills for technical and commercial documentation in English.
* Attributes & Work Ethic: Highly proactive, accountable, and result-oriented, with demonstrated capability in managing sales pipelines and key project accounts effectively.
